title: Mixing, editing: Cleanup Time, Hard Times Are Over, Beautiful Boys by John Lennon and Yoko Ono | 1980
content:
Hit Factory, New York City
Producers: John Lennon, Yoko Ono, Jack Douglas
Engineer: Lee DeCarlo

The final studio session for John Lennon and Yoko Ono’s Double Fantasy album took place on 19 October 1980.

The session began at 7am, an unusually early start, and was the second remixing session for Lennon’s song ‘Cleanup Time’. The song had been recorded on 13 August and 5 and 17 September 1980.

Lennon was not present for the remix, but Ono oversaw the day’s work.

With ‘Cleanup Time’ complete within two hours, work began on editing the song, as well as final fixes for Ono’s songs ‘Hard Times Are Over’ and ‘Beautiful Boys’.
